verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vue's source is publicly readable in the vuejs/core GitHub repository, so the read-the-source half of the story is supported. Nothing in the pack names the license or states that the code is distributed under open terms, so the open-license half is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the license (e.g. a LICENSE file or docs stating MIT/OSI terms), and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
